title: Container App
about: A containerised app (built from its Dockerfile, any language) on Azure Container Apps, in a Container Apps environment of the map: its own user-assigned managed identity pulls the image from a registry of the map and reads its Key Vault secrets, HTTPS only, optional Entra ID sign-in in front; deployed by GitHub Actions with OIDC (image built on the runner, tagged with the commit). The infrastructure never changes its image.
